SELECT membership.id AS membership_id, p.id AS principal_id, p.subject_id, p.tenant_id, COALESCE(p.display_name, i.display_name) AS display_name, membership.status AS membership_status, membership.version AS membership_version, p.status AS principal_status, p.version AS principal_version FROM iam_tenant_membership membership INNER JOIN iam_principal p ON p.membership_id = membership.id AND p.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND p.principal_type = 'TENANT' AND p.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN iam_subject i ON i.id = p.subject_id AND i.deleted = 0 WHERE membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.deleted = 0
AND membership.status = #{status}
AND ( p.display_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR i.display_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM iam_contact contact WHERE contact.subject_id = i.id AND contact.status = 'ACTIVE' AND contact.deleted = 0 AND contact.value ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') ) )
ORDER BY membership.created_at DESC, membership.id DESC

SELECT membership.id AS membership_id, p.id AS principal_id, p.subject_id, p.tenant_id, COALESCE(p.display_name, i.display_name) AS display_name, membership.status AS membership_status, membership.version AS membership_version, p.status AS principal_status, p.version AS principal_version FROM iam_tenant_membership membership INNER JOIN iam_principal p ON p.membership_id = membership.id AND p.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND p.principal_type = 'TENANT' AND p.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN iam_subject i ON i.id = p.subject_id AND i.deleted = 0 WHERE membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.deleted = 0 AND p.id = #{principalId}
